item.title: 10 Near-Perfect Netflix Sci-Fi Shows That Hook You in the First Scene
item.description: Not every great sci-fi show needs to start with a bang, but the best ones know how to grab your attention from the very first frame. Whether it’s a gruesome public execution in the middle of a cultural revolution, a child stepping into a smoke-filled battleground littered with corpses, or an alien organism mutating a host in seconds, the most compelling series understand the power of a great first impression. Such shows offer something tangible enough to keep you glued to your seat before the opening credits even roll.

item.title: One Piece Is Officially Coming to Fortnite
item.description: Fortnite 's next mini-season is a week away. The minor teasers that have surfaced thus far have made it clear that the upcoming season's theme will be an anime -pirate mash-up, and its main focus will be treasure hunting. That's about it. Epic Games has finally decided to pull the curtain back on the mini-season, and it's everything fans have been waiting for.

item.title: Clint Eastwood's Most Intense Western Is Officially Streaming for Free on YouTube
item.description: Throughout the 1960s, Clint Eastwood made the difficult leap from being a supporting player in a TV show to starring in movies as a headliner. That TV show was the Western series Rawhide and those movies were also primarily Westerns, most notably the three films which comprise “The Man with No Name Trilogy” — A Fistful of Dollars ; For a Few Dollars More ; and The Good, the Bad and the Ugly .

item.title: Commander Shepard Voice Actors Call for Action to Save Mass Effect
item.description: News of BioWare shutting down and the development of Mass Effect Universe ending hit fans hard this week. The community is coming together on a large scale in an attempt to save the beloved sci-fi action role-playing game's future. The latest high-profile supporters, Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer, the original voice actors for Commander Shephard, have joined the fight to keep Mass Effect alive and round up more fan support.

item.title: Hulu Officially Bringing Back 2000s Fan-Favorite Crime Drama
item.description: One of Fox’s most popular TV shows of all time is coming back under Disney . Hulu revealed a first look at Prison Break: Black Creek , a spinoff series set in the same universe as the original. The revival series of the early aughts crime drama series is now in production and is “coming soon” to Hulu and Disney Plus.

item.title: 3 Final Fantasy Games to Play if You Loved FF Resonance
item.description: The first HD-2D game in Square Enix's long-running RPG series, Final Fantasy Resonance , has finally arrived on consoles and Windows PC. Resonance is a love letter to the franchise, and it's jam-packed with cameos and references to Final Fantasy heroes old and new. Once you've had your fill of this new adventure, you might find yourself itching to revisit the olden days — or dive into a newer installment you may have missed. Here are three games that comprise a mini Final Fantasy retrospective, spanning the various phases of the franchise's history.

item.title: The 20 Most-Played Steam Next Fest Demos Features Troublemaking Students, Farting Hippos
item.description: Steam Next Fest is currently in full swing, and developers big and small have released new demos so players can discover their upcoming games. While the event runs through Oct. 26, Valve has already revealed to Polygon what the 20 most popular demos out of the 8,000+ games featured are. Multiplayer games dominate the list as friendslop continues to pull big numbers on Steam, as do a couple of shopkeeping sims. In descending order, these are the most-played games of Oct. 2026's crowded Steam Next Fest .

item.title: Stephen King's 10 Best Villains of All Time, Ranked
item.description: Stephen King has many novels, novellas, and short stories in his vault, from deeply vivid and memorable epics to narratives that inspired Academy Award-winning movies . One of the hallmarks of his writing is his ability to create truly memorable villains, whether they’re human or creatures from another world.
